description: Begin uploading a film's main film or trailer from the user's computer. Files cannot be sent through this connection: the tool returns an upload_url the user opens in their browser (signed in to Vidreno) to pick the file; the upload goes straight to Vidreno's film storage (outside plan storage) and is attached to the film when it finishes, replacing the current file in that slot. Afterwards call get_film to see the new file's state; get_upload_status with the upload_id works too. Links are single-use and expire after about an hour.

asset.description: Which file this is: the main film or the trailer. Replaces the current one once the upload finishes.

film_id.description: The film's public id (from list_films / get_film).

name: start_film_upload
title: Upload a film file
